outputs.image_review: Actually viewed original 1024x1024 atlas. Four separate full-body standing adult market figures in the requested order: woman with teapot, straw-hat man with vegetable basket, woman holding folded cloth, gray-haired older man with a small ceramic jar. Fine warm-brown linework and muted watercolor clothing. Full heads, hands, held props and shoes remain inside each cell. No table, counter, ground, cast shadow, text or watermark.
review_limits: Generated figures have restrained chibi proportions with longer adult bodies than an exact three-head ratio; compare their apparent size with the existing scene player before acceptance.
Requested six-percent top/bottom margin was not fully met. Measured minimum margin is eight pixels, but all figures and shoes are complete and do not cross cell boundaries.
RGB background varies around near-magenta. Exact #FF00FF comparison is unsuitable. Cell-isolated sampling, tolerant keying and small-scale edge review are required.

Four distinct green clusters in requested order: fine bamboo leaves with short stems, low broadleaf herbs, a dense dark-green shrub, and airy vines with wall-base grass. Irregular readable leaves and openings; no autumn-yellow fan canopy. No pots, ground, cast shadow, scenery, text or watermark. All clusters remain wholly inside their cells with generous empty margins.
